newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes $2 higher, Brent near highs.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes $2 higher, Brent near highs.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed $2 a tonne higher on Tuesday, dragged upwards by a buoyant gasoline market in the United States, brokers said.
Front month August gas oil settled at $162.75 after touching $164 in the final hour of business. September settled at $164.25, up $1.75.
"Gasoline has been pretty dramatic over there and one can only assume that they are expecting a big drawdown on the APIs tonight," a dealer said.
Brokers put strong support for September gas oil at $160 with resistance at around $166.50.
IPE August Brent crude oil futures were up 25 cents at $18.07 a barrel, just four cents off the high, in another reflection of gasoline's rally.
NYMEX gasoline powered ahead on expectations that Tuesday's report from the American Petroleum Institute (API) will show possibly the last great drawdown of unleaded stocks of the summer.
Brent drew early strength from the August loading programme which was slightly below expectations and a reaction to Monday's sharp falls.
Brent system operator Shell Expro estimated North Sea Brent crude system throughput in August at 407,800 barrels per day (bpd), slightly lower than the 409,076 bpd pumped in July.
Foreign officials in Baghdad said on Tuesday there were no major obstacles remaining in the way of a resumption of Iraqi oil exports under an oil-for-food deal with the U.N.
